**Car:** (make, model, model year, region)

**Which tweaks are unavailable:**

**Report:** in Tweaks, select an unavailable tweak, insert a USB drive, and tap
*Save Compatibility Report to USB*. Attach the `tilepad-compat-….txt` file from the drive here.
It holds the head unit's software version and file hashes only; nothing personal and no OEM files.
